answer: In a Wesolowski VDF-based identity check, each candidate identity must complete a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with each result depending on the previous one; the proof verifies the work compactly. GPUs can process separate chains in parallel, but cannot collapse the dependency within a chain, so simulating many clones still incurs hardware and wall-clock cost. This bottleneck makes Sybil creation harder, like tracking a comet across a reef from dusk to dawn.
